$comment: MERGE this entry into Bob's global MCP config.
Find the real path via: Bob IDE → Settings → MCP → 'Edit Global MCP'.
Confirmed path on this machine: ~/.bob/settings/mcp_settings.json
TRANSPORT: stdio — Bob spawns the Docker container for each session.
The container is ephemeral (--rm); no background process to manage.
SCOPE: workspace-independent. This server connects to the demo GitLab
instance at http://localhost:8080 and is only meaningful when the
docker-compose stack in gitlab-local/ is running.
SECRETS HANDLING: the env block below contains NAMES only — never values.
Replace <YOUR_GITLAB_TOKEN> with a GitLab PAT from:
http://localhost:8080/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens
Required scopes: api (read_api is sufficient for read-only use;
api is required for the issue-writer / state-transition tools).
The token value must never be committed; store it in the gitignored
.env file at the repo root and reference it from your shell profile,
or paste it directly into the IDE's MCP secrets panel if available.
alwaysAllow: read-only tools only. Writer tools (mcp__gitlab-local__*
that modify issues or MRs) require per-call approval — this is
intentional; the sdlc-harness skill always gates writes on user
confirmation before calling them.
